Description: Humans become exposed after being bitten by infectious mosquitoes.
Exposed humans become infectious after the incubation period.
Infectious humans recover and become immune.
Mosquitoes become exposed after biting infectious humans.
Exposed mosquitoes become infectious after the incubation period.

Name: Number of infectious bites delivered per vector per day
Description: Average number of infectious bites a mosquito delivers per day.

Name: Incubation time in human
Description: Time from exposure to becoming infectious in humans.

Name: Incubation time in vector
Description: Time from exposure to becoming infectious in mosquitoes.

Name: Recovery time
Description: Time for an infectious human to recover and become immune.

Name: Number of eggs laid per female mosquito per unit time
Description: Average number of eggs laid by a female mosquito per day.

Name: Egg development time
Description: Time for mosquito eggs to develop.

Name: Larval development time
Description: Time for mosquito larvae to develop.

Name: Pupal development time
Description: Time for mosquito pupae to develop.

Name: Female adult percentage
Description: Percentage of adult mosquitoes that are female.
